title: Kilsat - Rane Knows Better
authorship: Three project-authored English adaptations of the original Aino and Rane satire; not translations of an external series.

episodes.title: The Free Commute
turns: I added up my commute. It costs more than my lunch.
Mine is free. I simply keep it outside my budget.
Fuel, tires, and repairs don't disappear outside your spreadsheet.
Those are car expenses. I just happen to be inside it.
I logged the trip in Kilsat. Those kilometers actually happened.
Then your driving log needs a more positive attitude toward numbers.
The car still needs fuel. Which budget is paying for that?
Cancel your lunch. My free commute needs a bigger budget.

episodes.title: The No-Travel Meeting
turns: Everyone drove here for a meeting about making fewer trips.
Exactly. You can't build a remote culture without showing up.
We could have stayed home and discussed this on a call.
And miss seeing who arrives early enough to find parking?
I logged today's trip in Kilsat. What should I call it?
Necessary travel. Never let the evidence undermine an important initiative.
All right. What's our actual decision for reducing unnecessary journeys?
We'll meet here again tomorrow. Attendance will demonstrate our progress.

episodes.title: The Savings Bonus
turns: I combined the client visits. One trip instead of three.
Excellent. My efficiency bonus should finally pay for this coffee.
You told me combining them would make the company look small.
I was testing your resilience. Obviously, my leadership worked perfectly.
The actual trips are in Kilsat. Your objections are in email.
You're obsessing over details instead of celebrating our shared success.
Shared success? You've just asked me to pay for your coffee.
Of course. My bonus is personal. Your sacrifice is a team effort.
